description: Malik said that originally, "Ghetto University" was "just me and Elton John". Elton John was "on the keys". Contained a Muhammad Ali sample saying, "the champ is here;" which can be heard on versions from the beat copy. Malik attempted to create rhymes around it, but ended up telling the engineer to remove the sample to clear space on the song. After having taken the sample out, he eventually came up with the "all of the lights" part after thinking about his son's first words which were "light". Kanye did not want the track on the album originally, but came convinced over time.

title: ✨ Ty Dolla $ign - Woke Up
description: Ty Dolla $ign song with a feature from Kanye, likely a freestyle given to him similar to "Guard Down". Has a minute of rapping and singing vocals from Kanye, as well as punch-ins and verses from Ty Dolla over the initial reference track. Samples "Paradise" by Jeremih. Mistaken as a LOVE EVERYONE track, since the producer for "Paradise" revealed Kanye had reached out Christmas 2016 for the stems - later using them to make an altered version of the song to use as background for a sentimental home video posted by Kim Kardashian to twitter. Also thought to be made later because "Paradise" wasn't released until December 2015, but it was found that the song was previewed before, with Jeremih's album having already been delayed multiple times since 2013. Original snippet leaked April 17th, 2024. Leaked after a successful Soakbuy.
